accuracy_notes: Agricultural land classification polygons were not promoted without exact canonical parcel intersection, survey resolution and proposal-area evidence.
Grade 3 examples were not treated as BMV because the platform examples did not establish subgrade 3a versus 3b.
Protected-wreck design expected count 57 and live dataset count 58 were both recorded; live authoritative data and designation documents take precedence.
Road centrelines, classification narratives and partial rights-of-way coverage were not converted into legal highway extent, access or capacity conclusions.
Backlog healthcare, fire, school, water and habitat considerations were retained as coverage gaps and never interpreted as absence of services or constraints.
No parcel relation, future-growth score or business row was fabricated.
